title: 230 V copper TPS (2C+E) – guidance
source: Prysmian Cable Guide (Australia), 2-core PVC 75 °C, 40 °C ambient; Olex handbook gives the same mV/A·m
note: Guidance only, not a substitute for AS/NZS 3008.1.1. Ratings are for one circuit; grouping, ambient above 40 °C and insulation reduce them. AS/NZS 3000 allows 5% total drop from the point of supply (11.5 V at 230 V) – that includes mains and submains.
